packs.title: Stickers
packs.description: Create, edit, import and export sticker packs

rail.label: Sticker packs
rail.shadowed: Hidden by my pack with the same name
rail.itemLabelShadowed: {{title}}, {{count}} stickers, hidden by my pack with the same name

head.shadowed: Hidden by my pack with the same name: :{{folder}}/…: shows mine; write :{{writing}}/…: for this one.

group.unlisted: In the folder, not added yet
group.commonTip: Common stickers go into the prompt with their descriptions; the model has to look up the rest.

grid.dropEmpty: Drop images here, or click to choose files

panel.label: Properties
panel.name: Name
panel.unlistedHint: In the folder, not in the pack yet
panel.nameRule: A name starts with a letter or _, uses only letters, digits, _ and -, and has at most 32 characters.
panel.stickerDisplayTip: Stickers show large even within text, and the line grows taller. Only changes how you see them; the pack is not modified.
panel.pluginNote: This pack comes from a plugin or is built in, so it is read-only. Copy it to mine to edit it.
panel.invalidHint: Under “More” you can show it in its folder or delete it.

create.title: New sticker pack
create.hint: The pack name goes into the syntax: {{syntax}}

rename.title: Rename pack
rename.warnTitle: Stickers written with the old pack name stop resolving
rename.warnMessage: Syntax already written in chats and files, like {{example}}, will show as plain text; renaming back makes it resolve again.
rename.usageLoading: Looking for Profiles that use it…
rename.usageList: These Profiles selected it and need it selected again on the Profile page after renaming: {{names}}
rename.usageGeneric: Profiles that selected it need it selected again after renaming.

conflict.title: A sticker pack named {{name}} already exists
conflict.refreshed: The existing pack was just changed elsewhere. Choose again.
conflict.noToken: The existing pack's version cannot be read, so it cannot be replaced. Save as a copy instead.

deletePack.title: Delete sticker pack “{{name}}”?
deletePack.description: Its {{count}} stickers and all images are deleted and cannot be restored.

deleteSticker.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteSticker.description: The image file is deleted too and cannot be restored.

notify.title: Stickers
notify.resized: {{count}} images were too large and were scaled down.
notify.revealNoDesktop: This machine has no desktop, so the folder can't be opened. Location: {{path}}
notify.unknownOutcome: Not sure whether the write succeeded; sticker packs were reloaded.

error.not-user-pack: Packs from plugins and built-in packs can't be changed. Copy it to mine first.
error.pack-exists: A pack with that name already exists.
error.pack-changed: The pack was just changed elsewhere. The page has refreshed; try again.
error.folder-invalid: A pack name uses only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, and doesn't start or end with a hyphen.
error.name-invalid: That name isn't valid: it starts with a letter or _, uses only letters, digits, _ and -, and has at most 32 characters.
error.name-duplicate: Another sticker already uses that name.
error.description-invalid: A description has at most 200 characters.
error.sticker-missing: This sticker is no longer in the manifest.
error.manifest-full: The manifest is full: at most 500 stickers and 256 KiB.
error.permission-denied: No permission to write this folder.
error.write-failed: The write didn't finish and may be partly done; trust what the page shows now.
error.refresh-failed: Written, but the page couldn't refresh. Reopen the page.
error.busy: Another import, export or upload is running. Try again shortly.
error.import-conflict: A pack with that name already exists.
error.export-too-large: Too large to export: a zip is at most 64 MiB and 600 files.
error.export-empty: No images, so the exported pack couldn't be imported back.
error.pack-invalid: This pack is invalid. Fix it in the folder first.
error.timeout: No data for a long time, so the connection was closed.
error.cross-site: Requests from other web pages are not accepted.
error.title-invalid: The display name can be at most 200 characters.
error.export-conflict: Two file names differ only in letter case, so the exported zip could not be imported back. Rename one of them in the folder first.
error.file-unreadable: The file can no longer be read. Choose it again.

reject.file-invalid: the file name can't be used
reject.type-mismatch: the content doesn't match the extension, or isn't PNG, GIF, WebP or JPEG
reject.gif-too-large: a GIF over 1024 pixels or 2 MiB can't be shrunk
reject.animated-too-large: an animated WebP over 1024 pixels or 2 MiB can't be shrunk
reject.folder: folders aren't accepted, only image files

problem.symlink: It is a link and is not read. Replace it with a real folder.
problem.folder-name: The folder name is not allowed: use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. Changing the pack name fixes it.
problem.manifest-too-large: stickers.json is over 256 KiB. Remove some content.
problem.manifest-unreadable: stickers.json cannot be read or has a syntax error. Fix it in the folder.
problem.manifest-invalid: The content of stickers.json is not valid. Fix it in the folder.
problem.folder-unreadable: The folder cannot be read. Check its permissions.
